summary: Sanction necessity under Section 197 CrPC; discharge valid for PC Act charges but not IPC offences; Parkash Singh Badal precedent applied; no requirement for sanction under CrPC for IPC offences; High Court correctly rejected quashing petition under Section 482; allegations suffice for trial continuation; Kamal Shivaji Pokarnekar case cited on quashing standards; proceedings against appellant for IPC offences upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.120-B, s.420, s.468, s.471
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.19, s.197, s.239, s.482
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding criminal proceedings for IPC offences affirmed; appellant to face trial for Sections 120-B, 420, 468, 471 IPC charges.
